title: Nne a Wɔde Yɛ Atirimɔdensɛm
intro: Bere tenten ansa na onipa a odi kan no nantew asase so no, na abɔde bi a ɔwɔ tumi kɛse gyina asomdwoe a edi mũ ahemman bi mu, a akra a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sen biara atwa ho ahyia. Sɛ wɔde ahyɛde biako mae a, ɛnne biara kotow de brɛɛ ne ho ase —nanso ɛnne biako sɔree de kyerɛe sɛ wɔsɔre tia, na na saa asɔretia no bɛka wɔ mfe biara mu akosi Da a etwa to no. Hena ne saa abɔde a wahwe ase yi?
clues: Wɔbɔɔ me fii biribi a ɛhyew denneennen mu, bere a afoforo a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn no, wɔde nea wɔnantew so hyehyɛɛ wɔn.
Metenaa beae kronkron bi wɔ abɔde a wɔatu wɔn ho ama mu, kosii sɛ ahyɛde biako danee biribiara danee.
Bere a ahyɛde no bae no, ɔkra biara kotow gye me; ahantan na ɛwoo me pow no.
Wɔpam me fii saa beae kronkron no, na wɔde nnome a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ahyɛ no agyirae.
Mesrɛɛ berɛ kosii Owusɔreɛ Da no, na wɔmaa ho kwan. Mekaa ntam sɛ mɛbɛn ɔkra biara na madi wɔn kwan.
Sɛ torobɛnto no bɔ a, wɔn a wodii m’akyi no bɛkyɛ me nkrabea, na wɔbɛka me ho wɔ ogya a ɛredɛw a ɔboafo biara ntumi nnye wɔn nkwa mu.

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
